visual.description: BPA exposure escalation counter. Multi-phase: Phase 1 — 'Dry contact' label, counter shows '~1×' (near limit), neutral tone. Phase 2 — 'Add sweat' text-rotate transition, counter rapidly climbs from 1 to 570 with glow surface intensifying. Final state: '570×' in large JetBrains Mono with 'the EU safe daily limit' subtitle. The escalation from ~1x to 570x is the dramatic arc. Film grain for cinematic weight.

dataChart.title: BPA Exposure: Polyester Activewear
dataChart.subtitle: vs EU tolerable daily intake (0.2 ng/kg bw/day)

notes: Second use of glow surface in the video — justified because this is the BPA section's headline stat and echoes the opening hook (scene-001). The escalation from dry to sweat-soaked is the key narrative moment. Counter should accelerate non-linearly (slow start, fast finish) for dramatic effect.
